fields.description: Stored 16-bit integrity word at save+4. Computed by FUN_08005d14 (custom seed/xor-sum over u16 words from save+6); written by FUN_08005cb8 (init) and FUN_0800e974 (commit); verified by FUN_08005c04/FUN_08005c58. Baseline holds 0x190e. No Schema v2 algorithm matches, so it is mapped as data, not a checksums[] entry.
fields.evidence: FUN_08005d14 sums (index ^ DAT_08005d58 ^ word) from buffer+6 with seed DAT_08005d50; FUN_08005cb8 and FUN_0800e974 store the low 16 bits at buffer+4; FUN_08005c04 and FUN_08005c58 compare buffer+4 against a fresh FUN_08005d14 result.
fields.name: stored_integrity_word

fields.description: Save-status flag word at save+8. Bit0 is set by the commit routine and tested on boot to decide whether save data is present (gates title-menu branch). Baseline 0x0000 (fresh save, flag clear).
fields.evidence: FUN_0800e974 sets bit0 of the u16 at save-buffer+8 (base DAT_0800eaa8) before recomputing the checksum; FUN_0800eb1c returns (((u16*)(base+8))&1)!=0 (base DAT_0800eb34) and FUN_08006094 branches the title menu on that result.
fields.name: save_status_flags
